caption: The drawing depicts the bust of a middle-aged woman positioned centrally within an oval frame. She has straight brown hair parted down the center and styled flat against her head. Her skin is pale, and her facial features include light-colored eyes, thin eyebrows, a straight nose, and closed, unsmiling lips. She is dressed in a dark gray or black buttoned garment with a high, white ruffled collar. The garment features textured detailing and is fastened at the neck with a black ribbon that appears to have white flower or feather-shaped decorations attached on either side of the chest. The background consists of a muted gradient of grayish-blue tones, with the oval frame highlighted in a darker blue shade. Toward the bottom right of the image, the text “Mrs. Charlotte L. Root” is written in red or brown script.
title: Mrs. Charlotte Root
